On the reverse, in fresh ink, someone had written: Thank you for waiting for me.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯把薄雾照成淡金色，空荡的街口偶尔驶过一辆出租车。早餐铺卷起铁门，蒸汽先于人声升起。清洁工推着小车，扫帚轻轻擦过昨夜的落叶。高楼仍有几扇窗亮着，不知是谁未眠。远处传来第一声鸟鸣，天空渐渐发白，河面也有了微光。","w03":"• Recursion means solving a problem by using the same method on a smaller version of that problem.\n• Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and repeating until you find a toy.\n• A recursive program needs a stopping rule, like stopping when the box has no smaller box inside."}
